slides.title: Before you clean anything, do these 4 things first
Eat something and drink water
slides.body: Low fuel makes every task feel 10x harder. A snack first isn't procrastinating. It's prep.

slides.title: Put on sound
slides.body: Podcast, playlist, a show you've seen 9 times. Background noise gives our brains something to hold on to.

slides.title: Pick one finish line
slides.body: Not 'clean the kitchen'. Try 'counters clear' or 'sink empty'. A clear finish line makes starting easier.

slides.title: Get a trash bag and a basket
slides.body: Trash bag for trash, basket for things that belong in other rooms. No walking away mid-task to put one thing back.

slides.title: Things you don't need before cleaning
Starting is the hard part. So make starting the only goal.
Want a plan that starts for you?
slides.body: The Messy Brain Home Reset gives you a tiny daily start, 7 days in a row. Link in bio.
